# Check-in and impediment log template

Duplicate this section for a check-in that actually took place. Keep notes
concise, factual, and appropriate for everyone with repository access. Do not
include passwords, tokens, private evaluations, or sensitive customer or
employee information.

## Check-in

- **Date and time:**
- **Participants:**
- **Work period or objective discussed:**
- **What changed since the previous check-in:**
- **Next steps and owners:**
- **Decisions made:**

## Impediments

Add one row per impediment. If there are none, record “None reported” for that
check-in rather than leaving the section ambiguous.

| Impediment and impact | Owner | Help or decision needed | Next action | Due / revisit date | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| _Describe the actual blocker_ | _Name_ | _Specific help needed_ | _Action_ | _Date_ | _Open / In progress / Resolved_ |

## Resolution record

For each resolved impediment, record the resolution, date, and any remaining
follow-up. Do not mark an impediment resolved until the team has confirmed it.

> **Recordkeeping:** Do not create retrospective check-in entries for meetings
> that did not happen. If this template is being used for a one-week project,
> record only the check-ins the team actually held.
